proposal.reason: Main change is new host one-sided public APIs (pcclPutSignal/pcclSignal/pcclWaitSignal), config surface (numRmaCtx), and communicator property reporting, so device-api is primary. enqueue is needed for new RMA task types and plan scheduling/launch integration; copy-engine is needed for the in-node CE put/wait execution path and signal synchronization; gin is needed for the cross-node RMA proxy path, GIN proxy wrappers, plugin loading/selection, and progress logic; communicator is needed for capability negotiation, config parsing/defaults/version gating, async-error/free lifecycle wiring, and per-comm RMA state; profiler is needed for new RMA API event types and descriptors.
